quests.name: Destruction in Deadmines
quests.npc: Alba Fairmoon in Westfall. Progress her quest chain starting with Testing the Wells before entering Deadmines.
quests.objective: Place the explosives at the forge, then meet Alba at the rear exit.
chain: Testing the Wells [#92742] — Alba Fairmoon, Sentinel Hill, Westfall. · Use the sample kit at the wells at Jansen Stead and Molsen Farm. · Player-reported Westfall wells: Jansen Stead 56.7, 18.7; Molsen Farm 46.2, 38.3. Use the provided sample kit beside each well, then return to Alba.
Murloc Gills [#92744] — Alba Fairmoon, Sentinel Hill, Westfall. · Collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills from Westfall's coastal murlocs.

The State of the Mines [#92745] — Alba Fairmoon, Sentinel Hill, Westfall. · Defeat 4 Kobold Diggers at Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners at Gold Coast Quarry. · Optional player route: combine with The People's Militia. Clear Jangolode first, hand in the current militia quest and collect its next part, then visit Gold Coast Quarry. Prioritize Riverpaw Miners; the next Toxic Soil step takes you to Moonbrook for remaining militia kills. Militia quests are not Toxic Soil prerequisites.

Moonbrook Espionage [#92747] — Alba Fairmoon, Sentinel Hill, Westfall. · Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies around Moonbrook and its mine approach. · Player report: enter the building leading to the Deadmines tunnels in Moonbrook. Find supply crates in the caves before the instance portal; collect 8, then return to Alba.
Explosive Consultation [#92748] — Alba Fairmoon, Sentinel Hill, Westfall. · Find the engineer Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

A Dynamite Plan [#92749] — Sprite Jumpsprocket, Dwarven District, Stormwind. · If offered and required, obtain 10 Coarse Dynamite for Sprite. Check whether Detonation at a Distance is already offered before buying materials. · The published storyline includes this step, but beta players report it can be skipped. Accept a later offered step to advance the walkthrough; do not buy materials solely on this guide's say-so.
Detonation at a Distance [#92750] — Sprite Jumpsprocket, Dwarven District, Stormwind. · Visit Stormwind Intelligence in Old Town to arrange a remote detonator.
Detonation at a Distance [#92751] — Stormwind Intelligence, Old Town, Stormwind; ask Jasper Fel. · Deliver the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket.
Explosive Consultation [#92752] — Sprite Jumpsprocket, Dwarven District, Stormwind. · Take the explosives back to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.
After the run: rear exit → Alba Fairmoon → Destruction in Deadmines [#92819] → use the detonator. Do not hearth before completing this step.
notes: Toxic Soil: follow the current step through Westfall and Stormwind before your Deadmines run.

Use Extra-Destructive Explosives beside the forge inside Deadmines. Players report the placement spot near the centre of the Gilnid foundry room. After the run, leave through the rear exit instead of hearthing. Meet Alba in the hills behind Moonbrook, turn this in, and accept the second Destruction in Deadmines quest (92819) to use the detonator.
quests.turnin: Alba Fairmoon outside the Deadmines rear exit, in the hills behind Moonbrook.
